instruction: Change the default font in LibreOffice Writer to Times New Roman with size 12.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing default font and size. Evaluator checks for both font name and size settings. Multi-parameter configuration.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses postconfig to dump LibreOffice config file, which persists font settings
Both instruction requirements are covered: font name (Times New Roman) and font size (12)
Correct getter (get_cache_file) and metric (check_list) functions used with proper parameter handling
Data flow is correct: postconfig dumps config → getter reads file → metric checks regex patterns

Minor issue: Regex pattern '<prop oor:name="FontHeight".*<value>12' may match values like 120, 123, 12.5 (not exact match). Should be '<prop oor:name="FontHeight".*<value>12<' or similar to ensure exact value
Minor issue: Pattern doesn't verify Times New Roman is specifically the DEFAULT font - could match any occurrence in config, though this is acceptable for high-level verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Improve font size regex to ensure exact match: '<prop oor:name="FontHeight".*<value>12</value>' or '<prop oor:name="FontHeight".*<value>12<'
Consider adding more specific pattern to verify it's the default paragraph/character font, not just any font occurrence
